$comment: Player-facing descriptions of the game's tunable values, shown in the FtdModApi settings menu tooltips. Mods can add or override these with their own FtdModApi.descriptions.json file.
AdvCannon.AbsorbedRecoilForce: Share of recoil that still pushes the craft when an APS gun's recoil absorbers soak it up.
AdvCannon.BarrelRecoilCapacity: Recoil an APS barrel can absorb on its own, before hydraulic recoil absorbers (scaled by gauge).
AdvCannon.BarrelRecoilRefresh: How fast an APS barrel recovers its recoil capacity, per second (scaled by gauge).
AdvCannon.BaseAmmoCost: Ammo cost of an APS shell per module, before gauge scaling. Higher values make APS shells more expensive.
AdvCannon.BaseApPerMs: Armour piercing APS shells get per m/s of speed. Higher values make all APS kinetic shells punch through more armour.
AdvCannon.BaseBleederInaccuracyFactor: Inaccuracy multiplier for APS shells with a base bleeder.
AdvCannon.BaseBleederSpeedModifierBoost: Speed bonus a base bleeder gives APS shells (0.15 = +15%).
AdvCannon.BaseCoolDownIntakes: Base cooling factor for APS barrel cooldown time. Higher values shorten the cooldown between shots.
AdvCannon.BaseEmpDamage: EMP damage per APS EMP module, before gauge scaling.
AdvCannon.BaseExplosiveDamage: Explosive (HE) damage per APS HE module, before gauge scaling. Higher values make APS HE shells hit harder.
AdvCannon.BaseFireDamage: Fire fuel per APS incendiary module, before gauge scaling.
AdvCannon.BaseFlakDamage: Flak damage per APS flak module, before gauge scaling.
AdvCannon.BaseFragDamage: Frag damage per APS frag module, before gauge scaling. Also sets HEAT and HESH strength.
AdvCannon.BaseGpEnergy: Energy each gunpowder casing gives an APS shell. Higher values make APS shells faster for the same propellant.
AdvCannon.BaseHealth: Base health of an APS shell, before gauge and module modifiers.
AdvCannon.BaseInaccuracy: Base inaccuracy of APS guns, in degrees, before barrel length reduces it.
AdvCannon.BaseKineticDamage: Kinetic damage APS shells get per m/s of speed, before gauge and module modifiers. Higher values make APS shells hit harder.
AdvCannon.BasePowderDamage: Explosive damage from gunpowder when an APS shell's propellant cooks off.
AdvCannon.BaseRecoil: Recoil per APS module, before gauge scaling.
AdvCannon.BaseReloadTime: Base reload time of an APS shell, in seconds, before gauge and length scaling. Lower values mean faster reloads.
AdvCannon.BodyHealthModifier: Health modifier of the APS solid warhead body module.
AdvCannon.BodyKineticModifier: Kinetic damage modifier of the APS solid warhead body module.
AdvCannon.BodySpeedModifier: Speed modifier of the APS solid warhead body and penetration depth fuse.
AdvCannon.CasingCostModifier: Ammo cost of each APS gunpowder casing, compared with a normal module.
AdvCannon.CoolerMultiplierIncrease: How much each APS barrel cooler speeds up barrel cooldown.
AdvCannon.CoolingPenaltyPerExtraBarrel: Extra cooldown per additional APS barrel (0.2 = +20% per barrel).
AdvCannon.FlakRadiusFactor: How much bigger flak explosions are than HE explosions of the same damage.
AdvCannon.FlareAccuracyBoost: Accuracy bonus APS guns get just after a starshell flare lights the target.
AdvCannon.GeneralAPModifier: Armour piercing modifier shared by most normal APS modules (fuses, bodies).
AdvCannon.GeneralHealthModifier: Health modifier shared by most normal APS modules.
AdvCannon.GeneralKineticModifier: Kinetic damage modifier shared by most normal APS modules.
AdvCannon.GeneralSpeedModifier: Speed modifier shared by most normal APS modules.
AdvCannon.GravRamDamageFactor: Kinetic damage share APS shells keep when fitted with a graviton ram (0.7 = 70%).
AdvCannon.HeadFastApModifier: Armour piercing modifier of the APS armour piercing head.
AdvCannon.HeadFastKineticModifier: Kinetic damage modifier of the APS armour piercing head.
AdvCannon.HeadFastSpeedModifier: Speed modifier of fast APS heads (AP head, squash head, skimmer tip).
AdvCannon.HeadHpApModifier: Armour piercing modifier of the APS hollow point head.
AdvCannon.HeadHpKineticModifier: Kinetic damage modifier of the APS hollow point head.
AdvCannon.HeadMediumApModifier: Armour piercing modifier of the APS heavy head.
AdvCannon.HeadMediumKineticModifier: Kinetic damage modifier of the APS heavy head.
AdvCannon.HeadMediumSpeedModifier: Speed modifier of the APS heavy head.
AdvCannon.HeadSabotAngleModifier: How much the APS sabot head reduces penalties from angled hits.
AdvCannon.HeadSabotApModifier: Armour piercing modifier of the APS sabot head.
AdvCannon.HeadSabotKineticModifier: Kinetic damage modifier of the APS sabot head.
AdvCannon.HeadSkimmerApModifier: Armour piercing modifier of the APS skimmer tip.
AdvCannon.HeadSlowSpeedModifier: Speed modifier of slow APS heads (HE, flak, EMP).
AdvCannon.HeadWeakAPModifier: Armour piercing modifier of weak APS heads (HE, EMP, frag).
AdvCannon.HeadWeakHealthModifier: Health modifier of soft APS heads (squash, HEAT). Heads at or below this count as soft.
AdvCannon.HeadWeakKineticModifier: Kinetic damage modifier of weak APS heads (HE, EMP, frag).
AdvCannon.HeatHeshMultiplier: Strength multiplier for APS HEAT and squash-head (HESH) charges.
AdvCannon.HeshThumpAp: Armour piercing of the thump damage from APS squash-head (HESH) shells.
AdvCannon.HydraulicRecoilCapacity: Recoil each metre of APS hydraulic recoil absorber can soak up.
AdvCannon.HydraulicRecoilCapacityLengthM: Extra capacity longer hydraulic recoil absorbers get.
AdvCannon.HydraulicRecoilRefresh: How fast each metre of hydraulic recoil absorber recovers, per second.
AdvCannon.MaxBarrelContractionSec: Longest time, in seconds, the APS barrel recoil animation takes. Visual only.
AdvCannon.MaxFuseLength: Largest length, in metres, of APS fuse modules.
AdvCannon.MultiBarrelCoolerFactorStep: Extra cooler effect per barrel on multi-barrel APS guns.
AdvCannon.MultiBarrelInaccuracy: Inaccuracy multiplier for multi-barrel APS guns.
AdvCannon.MultiBarrelInaccuracyStep: Extra inaccuracy per additional APS barrel.
AdvCannon.MuzzleFlashSizeModifier: Size of APS muzzle flashes. Visual only.
AdvCannon.RailAccuracyModifier: How much railgun charge improves APS accuracy.
AdvCannon.RailBarrelRailEnergy: Railgun energy capacity each rail magnet adds to an APS gun.
AdvCannon.RailCasingCostModifier: Ammo cost of each APS railgun casing, compared with a normal module.
AdvCannon.RailCasingModifier: How much extra rail draw each APS railgun casing allows.
AdvCannon.RailCasingRecoilFactor: Recoil share from railgun energy drawn through railgun casings.
AdvCannon.RailChargerEnergy: Railgun energy each APS railgun charger adds per second.
AdvCannon.RailMagnetEnergy: Railgun energy capacity each APS rail attach point adds (0 by default).
AdvCannon.RailMaxShellDraw: Most railgun energy an APS shell can draw per module. Higher values allow faster railgun shells.
AdvCannon.RecoilInaccuracyIncrease: Extra APS inaccuracy from heavy recoil.
AdvCannon.SabotApModifier: Armour piercing modifier of the APS sabot warhead body.
AdvCannon.SabotHealthModifier: Health modifier of APS sabot modules.
AdvCannon.SabotKineticModifier: Kinetic damage modifier of the APS sabot warhead body.
AdvCannon.SabotSpeedModifier: Speed modifier of the APS sabot warhead body.
AdvCannon.ShieldAngleVariance: How much the hit angle changes what a shield does to a shell.
AdvCannon.ShieldBaseDisruptRegen: How fast shields recover from EMP disruption.
AdvCannon.ShieldMaxDisruptionEMP: EMP damage that fully disrupts a shield. Lower values make EMP better at knocking shields down.
AdvCannon.ShieldMinReflect: Smallest chance a shield reflects a shell.
AdvCannon.ShieldStrengthRange: How much extra shield drive improves a shield's strength.
AdvCannon.TracerTrailLengthMultiplier: Length of APS tracer trails. Visual only.
AdvCannon.VolumeModifierExponent: How strongly APS shell stats grow with gauge. Changing it rescales most APS damage, cost and reload maths.
AdvCannon.VolumeWeakModifierExponent: How strongly some APS stats (like reload) grow with gauge, for the weak scaling.
AdvCannon.WeakAPModifier: Armour piercing modifier of APS explosive modules (HE, frag, HEAT secondary).
AdvCannon.WeakHealthModifier: Health modifier of fragile APS modules (fuses and similar).
Campaign.AllowForcingOutOfPlayDueToBlock: When on, the campaign may move craft out of play when a battle goes over the block limit. Appears unused in the current game version, so changing it may do nothing.
Campaign.AreaCaptureDistanceFromGarrison: How close, in metres, attackers must get to a garrison to capture its area (shown as the red ring on the map).
Campaign.AreaCapureDistanceFromGarrisonF: Distance, in metres, around a garrison that defenders hold when protecting an area.
Campaign.blockadeStartDistance: Distance, in metres, at which enemy fleets start a blockade (battle) with each other on the campaign map.
Campaign.BlueprintAltitude: Altitude used for blueprint craft on the campaign map.
Campaign.BlueprintSpeed: Speed used for blueprint craft on the campaign map.
Campaign.defendBoardSectionFleetIntercep: Range, in metres, at which AI fleets defending an area go to intercept enemies. Appears unused in the current game version, so changing it may do nothing.
Campaign.distanceFromFleetBeforeAutoLeav: Distance, in metres, a craft can stray from its fleet in battle before it automatically leaves play.
Campaign.DumpPickupDistance: Distance, in metres, within which a craft picks up dumped resources.
Campaign.fleetEnterAttackingForcesObject: Range, in metres, at which AI fleets start attacking. Appears unused in the current game version, so changing it may do nothing.
Campaign.fleetMergeDistance: Distance, in metres, within which two fleets can be merged.
Campaign.forceMaxDistanceFromFleet: Furthest a craft can be placed from its fleet's centre, in metres.
Campaign.leaveAttackingForcesObjectiveAb: Range, in metres, at which AI fleets stop chasing an attack target. Appears unused in the current game version, so changing it may do nothing.
Campaign.leaveEngagingObjectiveAboveThis: Range, in metres, at which AI fleets stop an engagement. Appears unused in the current game version, so changing it may do nothing.
Campaign.MaxDistanceFromFleetInBattleSet: Furthest you can place a craft from its fleet during battle setup, in metres.
Campaign.MinDistanceFromEnemyForceInBatt: Closest you can place a craft to an enemy during battle setup, in metres.
Campaign.OutOfPlayRepairRange: Distance, in metres, within which friendly craft can repair each other while out of play.
Campaign.patrolObjectiveEndsWhenWaypoint: How close, in metres, a patrolling fleet must get to a waypoint to count as reaching it. Appears unused in the current game version, so changing it may do nothing.
Campaign.ResourceUsageDistance: Distance, in metres, within which a craft can draw resources from a resource store.
Campaign.retreatDistanceFromOtherFleetsT: Distance, in metres, a retreating fleet must reach from enemies to be safe. Appears unused in the current game version, so changing it may do nothing.
Campaign.SupplyGroupDistance: Distance used to group supply fleets (used by the resources tutorial).
Campaign.supportingFightObjectiveEndsWhe: Range, in metres, that AI fleets supporting a fight check for enemies before giving up. Appears unused in the current game version, so changing it may do nothing.
Cram.AmmoPerPayload: Ammo a CRAM cannon uses per unit of payload packed into a shell. Higher values make CRAM shells more expensive.
Cram.BaseAzimuth: How far, in degrees, a CRAM turret can turn left and right before elevation barrels reduce it.
Cram.BaseBarrelMass: Base mass used for CRAM barrel stats. Heavier barrels slow turret turning.
Cram.BaseBarrelSpeed: Base speed at which CRAM barrels traverse, before shell size slows them.
Cram.BaseElevation: How far, in degrees, a CRAM turret can aim up and down.
Cram.BaseVelocity: Base muzzle velocity of CRAM shells, in m/s, before barrel upgrades. Higher values make CRAM shells fly faster and further.
Cram.BoxCapacityFactor: Extra packing capacity each CRAM compactor adds (0.05 = +5% per compactor).
Cram.FuseHealthPenalty: Shell health lost per fuse fitted to a CRAM shell (0.1 = −10% per fuse).
Cram.GaugeIncrement: Gauge, in metres, each CRAM gauge increaser adds (0.05 = 50 mm).
Cram.HardenerHealthPerPayload: Shell health each hardener pellet adds to a CRAM shell.
Cram.HardenerKineticPerPayload: Impact damage each hardener pellet adds to a CRAM shell.
Cram.HealthPerPayload: Shell health each non-hardener pellet (HE, frag, EMP, fire) adds to a CRAM shell.
Cram.KineticMaxAp: Most armour piercing a CRAM shell can reach when it is all hardener pellets.
Cram.KineticPerPayload: Impact damage each non-hardener pellet adds to a CRAM shell.
Cram.MaxGauge: Largest CRAM shell gauge, in metres (2 = 2000 mm).
Cram.MaxGaugeBaseCapacity: Pellet capacity of a CRAM cannon at the largest gauge.
Cram.MaxGaugePackDelay: Seconds between packing steps for a CRAM cannon at the largest gauge.
Cram.MaxInterceptorDamageTaken: Share of interceptor damage the largest CRAM shells take (0.8 = 80%).
Cram.MinAzimuth: Smallest left/right turning range, in degrees, a CRAM turret keeps no matter how many elevation barrels it has.
Cram.MinGauge: Smallest CRAM shell gauge, in metres (1 = 1000 mm).
Cram.MinGaugeBaseCapacity: Pellet capacity of a CRAM cannon at the smallest gauge.
Cram.MinGaugePackDelay: Seconds between packing steps for a CRAM cannon at the smallest gauge.
Cram.MinInterceptorDamageTaken: Share of interceptor damage the smallest CRAM shells take (0.4 = 40%).
Cram.PackTimeStep: Length of each CRAM packing step, in seconds. Advanced; small changes affect packing timing.
Cram.RecoilPerPayload: Recoil per CRAM pellet. Appears unused in the current game version, so changing it may do nothing.
Cram.ShellPowerPerPayload: Explosive, frag and EMP power each pellet adds to a CRAM shell. Higher values make CRAM payloads hit harder.
CustomJet.AddonEfficiency: Efficiency each add-on (compressor, injector) gives a large custom jet.
CustomJet.CombusterFuelPerSec: Fuel a large custom jet combuster burns per second.
CustomJet.CombusterThrust: Base thrust of a large custom jet combuster.
CustomJet.ExhaustEfficiencyBonus: Efficiency bonus from fitting an exhaust to a custom jet (0.1 = +10%).
CustomJet.GeneratorPowerPerThrust: Engine power a custom jet generator makes per unit of jet thrust.
CustomJet.InjectorFuelFactor: How much extra fuel each custom jet fuel injector uses.
CustomJet.InjectorThrustFactor: How much extra thrust each custom jet fuel injector adds.
CustomJet.IntakeAddonEfficiencyBonus: Efficiency bonus each custom jet intake extension gives (0.025 = +2.5%).
CustomJet.IntakeClearanceNeeded: Empty space, in metres, a custom jet intake needs in front of it to work fully.
CustomJet.IntakeEfficiency: Most efficiency a clear custom jet intake can add.
CustomJet.IntakePipedEfficiency: Most efficiency a piped custom jet intake can add.
CustomJet.IntakePipeEfficiencyBonus: Efficiency each custom jet intake pipe adds.
CustomJet.NoIntakeEfficiency: Efficiency of a custom jet with no intake (0.6 = 60%).
CustomJet.SmallAddonEfficiency: Efficiency each add-on (compressor, injector) gives a small custom jet.
CustomJet.SmallCombusterFuelPerSec: Fuel a small custom jet combuster burns per second.
CustomJet.SmallCombusterThrust: Base thrust of a small custom jet combuster.
Detection.AimPointDetectionGracePeriod: Seconds an AI keeps aiming at a specific spot (from IR or radar cross-section data) after it last saw that spot.
Detection.ChaffStrengthMultiplier: How effective chaff is at hiding a craft from radar. Higher values make the same amount of chaff hide more.
Detection.DragHeatCoefficient: How much air friction (drag) heats a craft up, which makes it easier to see with infrared sensors. Higher values make fast craft hotter.
Detection.MaxECMSeedChangeInterval: Longest time, in seconds, between changes to the random noise an ECM jammer produces.
Detection.MissilePassiveSignatureCoeffic: How much noise launching a missile makes for passive sensors. Higher values make missile launches easier to detect.
Detection.ShieldHeatCoefficient: How much heat shield projectors give off, which infrared sensors can see. Higher values make shielded craft easier to spot.
Detection.SmokeStrengthMultiplier: How well smoke blocks sensors. Higher values make the same smoke hide craft better.
Detection.SmokeVisibility: How far smoke can be seen from, which affects how easily a smoking craft is spotted.
Detection.SonarSignaturePerForce: How much noise propulsion force makes for passive sonar. Higher values make moving craft easier to hear underwater.
Detection.SonarSignaturePerPower: How much noise running engines make for passive sonar. Higher values make powerful engines easier to hear.
Detection.SoundEventDecayConstant: How quickly loud noises (like gunfire) fade from a craft's passive sonar signature.
Detection.SoundEventMinimumDecayPerSecon: Minimum amount a loud noise fades from a craft's sonar signature every second.
Detection.WarpVelocityCompensationPeriod: Seconds after a craft warps during which enemy tracking ignores the sudden jump in speed.
Detection.WirelessSignaturePerBuoyDistan: How much radio signature a sonar buoy link gives off, per metre of distance between the buoy and its craft.
Detection.WirelessSignaturePerSharingDis: How much radio signature a craft gives off when sharing data wirelessly, per metre of range. Higher values make wireless users easier to find.
Drill.BaseArmorPiercing: Base armour piercing of drills. Appears unused in the current game version, so changing it may do nothing.
Drill.BaseDamagePerKinetic: Damage a drill does per unit of stored kinetic energy. Higher values make drills hit harder.
Drill.BaseKineticPerHit: Kinetic energy a drill spends per hit at full spin.
Drill.BaseRotationHz: Top drill spin speed, in turns per second. Faster drills hit more often.
Drill.LossPerSec: Share of stored kinetic energy a drill loses every second (0.01 = 1%).
Drill.MaxKineticPerBlock: Kinetic energy each drill block can store. More storage means longer bursts of drilling.
Drill.PowerUsePerInput: Engine power each drill power input uses, and the kinetic energy it adds per second.
Drill.ToolTipWidth: Width of drill tooltips, in pixels. Visual only.
Explosion.AirBleedPower: How strongly bigger explosions lose power in open air. Higher values make large blasts in the air weaker; lower values let them keep more of their damage.
Explosion.AirBleedRadius: How strongly a wide blast radius reduces the damage an explosion keeps in open air. Higher values make big-radius air bursts weaker.
Explosion.AirExplosionPowerReduction: Overall strength of the damage loss explosions suffer in open air (air bleed). Raise it to make air bursts weaker, lower it to make them hit harder.
Explosion.DamagedThresholdMaxDamage: Most damage an explosion can lose on a block it damages but does not destroy. Part of how much blast energy armour soaks up.
Explosion.DamagedThresholdPercent: Percent of a damaged block's health that is used when working out how much blast energy that block absorbs.
Explosion.ExplosionBoost: Multiplier on the damage of every explosion in the game (HE shells, missile warheads, ammo cook-offs and so on). 1 is normal, 2 doubles all explosive damage.
Explosion.ExtraEnergyLostOnBlockDestroye: Extra blast energy used up each time an explosion destroys a block. Higher values make explosions stop sooner as they chew through blocks.
Explosion.IsHitBlocksSeveralTimes: When on, an explosion can damage the same block more than once. Off is the game's normal behaviour.
Explosion.IsSortBlocksToDamage: When on, explosions damage the nearest blocks first and work outwards. Turning it off makes blast damage spread in a less realistic order.
Explosion.MaxExplosionRadius: Largest radius an explosion can reach, in blocks (metres). Bigger warheads stop growing once they hit this cap.
Explosion.NonDamagedBlocksBlastPercent: Percent of blast energy that carries past a block the explosion could not damage. Higher values let explosions reach further behind tough blocks.
Explosion.NonDestroyedBlocksBlastPercent: Percent of blast energy that carries past a block the explosion damaged but did not destroy.
Explosion.PowerToApplyToAC: How sharply armour reduces explosive damage. Higher values make armoured blocks shrug off explosions more.
Flamer.FlamerUnitsPerMaterial: Flamethrower fuel units made per material. Higher values make flamers cheaper to run.
Flamer.LTankThroughput: Flamer fluid each large tank can deliver per second. Also sets how big the fire is when it is destroyed.
Flamer.MaxCompressorPowerPerThroughPut: Engine power a flamer compressor uses per unit of fluid flow. Higher values make flamers more power hungry.
Flamer.SCompressorEfficiency: Power efficiency of small flamer compressors compared with large ones (0.75 = 75%).
Flamer.STankEfficiency: Fuel efficiency of small flamer tanks compared with large ones (0.75 = 75%).
Flamer.STankThroughput: Flamer fluid each small tank can deliver per second. Also sets how big the fire is when it is destroyed.
Flamer.TurnRate: How fast a flamethrower nozzle can turn, in radians per second.
Fuel.BaseCooling: Cooling every fuel engine cylinder gets for free, in °C per second, before radiators and exhausts.
Fuel.BaseFuelToPower: Engine power made per unit of fuel burned in a fuel engine. Higher values make fuel engines more fuel efficient.
Fuel.BlockedExhaustFactor: How well an exhaust works when its outlet is blocked by other blocks (0.5 = half as well).
Fuel.CarbFuelPerSec: Fuel per second a carburettor feeds into its cylinder. More fuel means more power and more heat.
Fuel.CoolingPerExhaust: Cooling each exhaust gives its cylinders, in °C per second.
Fuel.CoolingPerRadiator: Cooling each radiator surface gives a fuel engine, in °C per second (shared between the engine's cylinders).
Fuel.CoolingRange: Range used for fuel engine cooling calculations. Appears unused in the current game version, so changing it may do nothing.
Fuel.CylinderFuelPerSec: Fuel per second a fuel engine cylinder burns on its own, without carburettors or injectors.
Fuel.ExhaustGasPerFuel: Exhaust gas produced per unit of fuel burned. More gas feeds turbochargers but needs more exhausts.
Fuel.ExhaustParticleFactor: Amount of exhaust smoke effects fuel engines make. Visual only.
Fuel.FixedAtHeatFraction: Heat level (fraction of the overheat point) below which a fuel engine cylinder runs at full efficiency.
Fuel.HeatPerFuel: Heat produced per unit of fuel burned in a cylinder. Higher values make fuel engines overheat more easily.
Fuel.InjectorFuelPerSec: Fuel per second a fuel injector feeds into its cylinder. More fuel means more power and more heat.
Fuel.MaxHeatPenalty: Largest power loss a fuel engine can suffer from running hot. Appears unused in the current game version, so changing it may do nothing.
Fuel.OverheatAtFraction: Heat level (fraction of maximum) at which a fuel engine cylinder counts as overheating and loses power.
Fuel.SuperChargerBonusMultiplier: Power bonus a supercharger gives its fuel engine. Higher values make superchargers more effective.
Fuel.TurboChargerBonusMultiplier: Power bonus a turbocharger gives its fuel engine. Higher values make turbochargers more effective.
Fuel.TurboChargerGasForMaxBonus: Exhaust gas per second a turbocharger needs to give its full bonus. Lower values make turbochargers easier to saturate.
FuelRefinery.BaseEfficiency: Starting efficiency of a fuel refinery before upgrades (0.5 = 50% of materials become fuel).
FuelRefinery.CokerGasCapacity: Dangerous gas each coker can hold before the refinery is at risk.
FuelRefinery.CokerGasPerSec: Dangerous gas each coker produces per second while refining.
FuelRefinery.CrackerGasCapacity: Dangerous gas each cracker can hold before the refinery is at risk.
FuelRefinery.CrackerGasPerSec: Dangerous gas each cracker produces per second while refining.
FuelRefinery.CrackerMaterialsPerSec: Materials each cracker turns into fuel per second. Higher values make refineries faster.
FuelRefinery.DesalterBuildupHeMultiplier: How much bigger a refinery's explosion is when it has desalters fitted.
FuelRefinery.DesalterGasFactor: Share of dangerous gas left over when a refinery has desalters (0.4 = 40%).
FuelRefinery.ExplosionDamagePerGas: Explosion damage per unit of stored gas when a refinery is destroyed.
FuelRefinery.ExplosionDamagePerGasPerSec: Extra explosion damage, per gas produced each second, when a refinery is destroyed.
FuelRefinery.FlareGasPerSec: Dangerous gas each flare stack burns off per second.
FuelRefinery.FlareMaxTemperature: Highest temperature a flare stack reaches, which infrared sensors can see.
FuelRefinery.FlareStackCoolingPerSec: How quickly a flare stack cools down (share of its heat lost per second).
FuelRefinery.MaxAltitude: Altitude, in metres, above which a refinery stops working.
FuelRefinery.MaxEfficiencyBonus: Largest efficiency bonus a refinery can get from upgrades.
FuelRefinery.MaxOptimalAltitude: Altitude, in metres, below which a refinery works at full speed. Between this and the max altitude it slows down.
Game.BuildMaterialShareRadius: Distance, in metres, within which friendly craft share materials for building and repairs.
Game.InGameDrawDistanceForMarkers_Square: Squared distance at which in-game markers and icons are drawn (25,000,000 = 5 km). Visual only.
Game.MaterialAsAmmoAccessibilityPerUnit: How many materials per minute each ammo box lets weapons draw from the material store as ammo.
Game.MaterialAsFuelAccessibilityPerUnit: How many materials per minute each fuel tank lets engines and flamers draw from the material store as fuel.
Game.MaterialNeededToRunRefinery: Materials a refinery must be sitting on before it can run and produce global commodities.
Game.MaterialToSteamConversion: Steam produced per material burned in a steam boiler. Higher values make steam engines more fuel efficient.
Game.RadarDetectionRangePerCrossSectionU: How far away radar can see a craft, per unit of radar cross-section. Higher values make radar see further.
Game.SonarDetectionRangePerCrossSectionU: How far away sonar can hear a craft, per unit of sonar cross-section.
Game.SubconstructDetectionFactor: How much a craft's turrets and spin blocks add to its detection ranges compared with the main hull.
Game.VisualDetectionRangePerCrossSection: How far away cameras can see a craft, per unit of visible cross-section.
Game.WirelessTransmitRangeToSnoopRange: How far away wireless snoopers can pick up a craft's wireless transmitters, compared with the transmitter range.
Laser.APSSmokeAmount: Smoke made by APS smoke shells, per module. Smoke weakens lasers passing through it.
Laser.BaseCavitySize: Energy each laser cavity can store.
Laser.BaseCombinerAttenuation: How quickly laser damage drops off over distance, before focus optics reduce it.
Laser.BaseSmokeSpeedReduction: How strongly smoke reduces laser damage. Higher values make smoke less effective against lasers.
Laser.CavitySpawnPumpingSeconds: Seconds of pumping a laser starts with already stored when the craft spawns.
Laser.CombinerAccuracy: Base inaccuracy of a laser combiner, in degrees. Lower is more accurate.
Laser.CombinerFieldOfFireMultiplier: Multiplier on how wide an arc a laser combiner can fire in.
Laser.ContinuousApMultiplier: Armour piercing multiplier for continuous-wave lasers.
Laser.ContinuousDamagePerEnergy: Damage continuous-wave lasers do per unit of energy. Higher values make CW lasers stronger.
Laser.DetectionSmokeThreshold: Smoke strength at which laser rangefinders and laser trackers can no longer see through.
Laser.DispenserSmokePerMaterial: Smoke strength a smoke dispenser makes per material used.
Laser.EnergyPumpRatePerCubicMeter: Energy each cubic metre of laser pump adds per second. Higher values mean faster laser charging and more continuous damage.
Laser.LamsAttenuation: How quickly laser anti-missile (LAMS) damage drops off over distance.
Laser.LamsNodeAccuracy: Base inaccuracy of laser anti-missile (LAMS) nodes, in degrees.
Laser.PowerPerCavityEnergy: Engine power used per unit of laser energy. Higher values make lasers more power hungry.
Laser.PulsedApPerDoubler: Armour piercing each frequency doubler adds to pulsed lasers.
Laser.PulsedBaseAp: Base armour piercing of pulsed lasers. Appears unused in the current game version, so changing it may do nothing.
Laser.PulsedDamagePerEnergy: Damage pulsed lasers do per unit of energy. Higher values make pulsed lasers stronger.
Laser.PumpCavityCapacityEquivalent: Energy capacity that counts as one cubic metre of pump when working out a laser's intensity (armour piercing).
Laser.ShieldSmokeEquivalent: How much smoke each point of shield drive counts as when lasers pass through a shield.
Laser.SmokeStrengthSpeedThreshold: Speed, in m/s, above which a moving craft starts to thin out its own smoke.
Laser.SrCombinerAttenuation: How quickly short-range laser damage drops off over distance.
Laser.SrCombinerFieldOfFire: How wide an arc, in degrees, a short-range laser combiner can fire in.
Laser.SrCombinerMaxFocusAcc: Inaccuracy of a short-range laser focused at its longest range (600 m).
Laser.SrCombinerMaxFocusAp: Armour piercing multiplier of a short-range laser focused at its longest range (600 m).
Laser.SrCombinerMaxFocusDamage: Damage multiplier of a short-range laser focused at its longest range (600 m).
Laser.SrCombinerMinFocusAcc: Inaccuracy of a short-range laser focused at its shortest range (150 m).
Laser.SrCombinerMinFocusAp: Armour piercing multiplier of a short-range laser focused at its shortest range (150 m).
Laser.SrCombinerMinFocusDamage: Damage multiplier of a short-range laser focused at its shortest range (150 m).
Laser.WaterAttenuationMultiplier: How much faster lasers lose damage in water than in air.
Map.HeightMapResolution: Resolution of the campaign map's height grid. Changing it can break map generation; for advanced use only.
Map.mapHeight: Vertical scale of the strategic map view. Visual only.
Map.SplatMapResolution: Resolution of the campaign map's ground texture grid. Changing it can break map generation; for advanced use only.
Missile.BaseAmmoCost: Ammo cost per missile part, before size and part modifiers. Higher values make missiles more expensive to fire.
Missile.BaseAngularDrag: How strongly missile parts resist spinning. Higher values make missiles turn more sluggishly.
Missile.BaseDecoySignalStrength: Signal strength of missile decoys (radar and sonar buoys get half). Stronger decoys pull enemy missiles away more easily.
Missile.BaseDrag: Air and water drag of each missile part. Higher values slow missiles down more.
Missile.BaseEmpDamage: EMP damage per EMP warhead volume, before missile size scaling.
Missile.BaseExpDamage: Explosive (HE) damage per HE warhead volume, before missile size scaling. Higher values make missile warheads hit harder.
Missile.BaseFireFuel: Fire fuel per incendiary warhead volume, before missile size scaling. More fuel means longer, hotter fires.
Missile.BaseFragDamage: Frag damage per frag warhead volume, before missile size scaling. Also sets HEAT warhead strength.
Missile.BaseFuel: Fuel per missile fuel tank volume. More fuel lets missiles thrust for longer.
Missile.BaseHarpoonLength: Cable length, in metres, each harpoon cable drum adds.
Missile.BaseHarpoonStrength: Strength of harpoon cables and winches.
Missile.BaseHealth: Health of each missile part, before size and part modifiers. Higher values make missiles harder to shoot down.
Missile.BaseInterceptorRange: Range of missile interceptors. Appears unused in the current game version, so changing it may do nothing.
Missile.BaseInterferenceError: How far off target radio interference can push remote-guided missiles.
Missile.BaseMagnetRange: Range, in metres, of missile magnets.
Missile.BaseMass: Mass of each missile part, before size and part modifiers.
Missile.BaseReloadTime: Base reload time of a missile launcher, in seconds (scaled by missile length). Lower values mean faster reloads.
Missile.BaseRemoteGPP: Guidance processing power (GPP) used by remote and Lua-guided missiles.
Missile.BaseSmokeError: How far off target smoke can push laser-designated missiles.
Missile.BaseThrustDetectionRange: How far a missile's thrust can be seen from by enemy sensors. Higher values make missiles easier to detect.
Missile.BaseThrustLimit: Most thrust a missile thruster or missile propeller can make, before size scaling.
Missile.BaseThumpAP: Armour piercing of impact (thump) missile warheads.
Missile.BaseThumpPerMs: Impact damage per m/s of speed for thump warheads, before size scaling.
Missile.BaseTurnrate: Base missile turning rate (reduced for longer missiles). Higher values make missiles more agile.
Missile.BombDropSpeed: Speed, in m/s, at which bombs leave their launch pad.
Missile.CiwsDamageMultiplier: Damage multiplier for close-in defences (interceptors, flak and the like) hitting missiles and CRAM shells.
Missile.CiwsDiameterMultiplier: How much larger missiles and CRAM shells count as when close-in defences try to hit them. Higher values make them easier to shoot down.
Missile.MaxRemoteError: Worst targeting error, in metres, of remote-guided missiles with no guidance processing power.
Missile.MaxStabilityError: Worst targeting error, in metres, of remote-guided missiles when the firing craft is very unstable.
Missile.MinRemoteError: Smallest targeting error, in metres, of remote-guided missiles.
Missile.MinTurnRateSpeed: Speed, in m/s, used to scale how missiles lose turning ability as they go faster.
Missile.ProcessorRemoteError: How much a signal processor reduces remote-guidance interference error (0.5 = halves it).
Missile.TurnThrusterFuelUse: Fuel used per second by missile turning thrusters.
Missile.TurnThrusterInacc: Inaccuracy added by missile turning thrusters, in degrees.
Missile.TurnThrusterStrength: How much missile turning thrusters improve turning.
Missile.UnderWaterDetectionRange: Detection range of missiles underwater. Appears unused in the current game version, so changing it may do nothing.
Missile.UnderWaterInterceptorDamage: Share of interceptor damage applied to targets underwater (0.8 = 80%).
Missile.UsefulDecoyCount: How many different decoy signals a missile tracks. Advanced; changing it can break decoy handling.
Missile.WinchForcePerPower: Pulling force a harpoon winch makes per unit of engine power.
ParticleCannon.BaseAttenuation: How quickly particle cannon damage drops off with distance. Higher values make PACs weaker at long range.
ParticleCannon.DefaultReloadTime: Starting charge time, in seconds, of a newly placed particle cannon.
ParticleCannon.FaultyDamageFactor: Damage share a badly built particle cannon arm deals (0.2 = 20%).
ParticleCannon.FocusFactor: How much particle cannon focus settings narrow the beam spread.
ParticleCannon.HitPowerPerEnergy: Particle cannon hit power per unit of energy. Appears unused in the current game version, so changing it may do nothing.
ParticleCannon.ImpactAp: Armour piercing of particle cannon impact (thump) damage.
ParticleCannon.MaxReloadTime: Longest charge time, in seconds, a particle cannon can be set to.
ParticleCannon.MeleeDamageFactor: Damage multiplier of the particle cannon melee lens.
ParticleCannon.MeleeFirepowerFactor: Firepower rating multiplier for melee-lens particle cannons. Affects AI and display ratings, not damage.
ParticleCannon.MinReloadTime: Shortest charge time, in seconds, a particle cannon can be set to.
ParticleCannon.PiercingAp: Armour piercing of particle cannon piercing damage.
ParticleCannon.PipeEnergyPerSec: Energy each metre of particle cannon pipe charges per second. Higher values mean faster charging.
ParticleCannon.PortAttenuationFactor: Range drop-off of particle cannon arms fed through an input port, compared with normal (0.5 = half the loss).
ParticleCannon.PortDamageFactor: Damage of particle cannon arms fed through an input port, compared with normal (0.8 = 80%).
ParticleCannon.Range: Length of the particle cannon beam effect, in metres.
Physics.AirDensityWaterLevel: Air density at sea level. Affects drag and lift of wings and air propulsion.
Physics.ControlSurfaceDragFactor: How much drag control surfaces (fins, rudders, wings) create compared with the force they produce.
Physics.DebrisAngularDragPerKilo: How quickly spinning debris slows its rotation, per kilogram.
Physics.DebrisDragPerKilo: How quickly flying debris slows down, per kilogram.
Physics.ExplosionDamageToForceFactor: How hard explosions push craft around, compared with the damage they do.
Physics.UniversalForceScaleFactor: Internal scale between game masses and forces and the physics engine. Changing it will very likely break physics; do not touch unless you know why.
Physics.WaterDensity: Density of water. Affects buoyancy and water drag on every craft.
PlasmaCannon.AirDamageFactor100: Share of plasma damage kept per 100 m of air travelled (0.995 = 99.5%).
PlasmaCannon.AirDamageFactor100Stab: Share of plasma damage kept per 100 m of air for stabilised plasma emitters.
PlasmaCannon.ArmorPiercing: Armour piercing of plasma cannon shots.
PlasmaCannon.BaseCooling: Cooling every plasma cannon gets for free, in °C per second.
PlasmaCannon.BaseCoolingPerLength: Cooling each metre of plasma accelerator gives, in °C per second.
PlasmaCannon.BaseCoolingPerSink: Cooling each plasma cooler gives, in °C per second.
PlasmaCannon.BaseDamage: Base damage of a plasma charge. Appears unused in the current game version, so changing it may do nothing.
PlasmaCannon.ChargesPerChamberCell: Plasma charges each chamber block can hold.
PlasmaCannon.CoolerThreshold: Temperature, in °C, below which plasma coolers stop using energy.
PlasmaCannon.CoolingPerEnergy: Cooling plasma coolers give per unit of energy used.
PlasmaCannon.DestabArmorPiercing: Armour piercing of plasma shots from destabiliser emitters.
PlasmaCannon.EnergyPerCharge: Energy used to make each plasma charge.
PlasmaCannon.HitPowerPerCharge: Firepower rating per plasma charge. Affects AI and display ratings.
PlasmaCannon.MaxBonusInaccuracy: Most extra inaccuracy a plasma cannon can have. Appears unused in the current game version, so changing it may do nothing.
PlasmaCannon.MaxEnergyPerAccelerator: Most energy per charge each metre of plasma accelerator can add.
PlasmaCannon.MaxSpawnChargeSeconds: Seconds of charge a plasma cannon starts with when the craft spawns.
PlasmaCannon.MinInaccuracy: Smallest inaccuracy of a plasma cannon. Appears unused in the current game version, so changing it may do nothing.
PlasmaCannon.ShieldReductionFixed: Fixed share of plasma damage blocked by shields. Appears unused in the current game version, so changing it may do nothing.
PlasmaCannon.ShieldReductionVariable: Variable share of plasma damage blocked by shields. Appears unused in the current game version, so changing it may do nothing.
PlasmaCannon.TemperaturePerCharge: Heat added to a plasma cannon per charge fired, in °C.
PlasmaCannon.TemperaturePerEnergy: Heat added to a plasma cannon per unit of accelerator energy fired.
PlasmaCannon.TimePerCharge: Seconds one plasma generator block takes to make a charge. Lower values mean faster charging.
PlasmaCannon.WaterDamageFactor100: Share of plasma damage kept per 100 m of water travelled (0.7 = 70%).
PlasmaCannon.WaterDamageFactor100Stab: Share of plasma damage kept per 100 m of water for stabilised plasma emitters.
Propeller.ClearanceThreshold: Share of a propeller's area that must be clear of blocks for full efficiency (0.9 = 90%).
Propeller.FullThrustFactor: Thrust share given by each fully clear side of a propeller.
Propeller.MaxAsymmetryLoss: Largest efficiency loss from building an uneven (asymmetric) propeller (0.1 = 10%).
Propeller.MaxDegreesPerSec: Fastest a propeller is drawn spinning, in degrees per second. Visual only.
Propeller.PartialThrustFactor: Thrust share given by each partly blocked side of a propeller.
Propeller.ThrustPerPower: Thrust a propeller makes per unit of engine power. Higher values make propellers stronger.
Propeller.ThrustPerSweptArea: Most thrust a propeller can make per square metre of blade area.
Propeller.TopSpeed: Speed, in m/s, at which propellers stop giving thrust.
Propulsion.BaseIonForce: Base thrust of an ion thruster.
Propulsion.BaseJetForce: Base thrust of a simple jet.
Propulsion.BasePropellerForce: Base thrust of a simple propeller.
Propulsion.BaseWheelForce: Base driving force of a drive wheel (scaled by wheel size).
Propulsion.BaseWheelSteeringSpeed: How fast wheels turn when steering, in degrees per second (scaled by wheel size).
Propulsion.BaseWheelTopSpeed: Speed, in m/s, at which drive wheels stop pushing (scaled by wheel size).
Propulsion.IonClearance: Empty space, in metres, an ion thruster needs behind it to work at full strength.
Propulsion.IonThrustPerPower: Thrust an ion thruster makes per unit of engine power.
Propulsion.IonTopSpeed: Speed, in m/s, at which ion thrusters stop giving thrust.
Propulsion.JetClearance: Empty space, in metres, a simple jet needs behind it to work at full strength.
Propulsion.JetThrustPerPower: Thrust a simple jet makes per unit of engine power.
Propulsion.JetTopSpeed: Speed, in m/s, at which simple jets stop giving thrust.
Propulsion.MaxPowerScale: Highest power setting simple propulsion can be overdriven to (4 = 400%).
Propulsion.MaxPowerScalePowerUseIncrease: Extra power cost of overdriving simple propulsion to its highest power setting (0.5 = 50% less efficient at max).
Propulsion.PropellerClearance: Empty space, in metres, a simple propeller needs behind it to work at full strength.
Propulsion.PropellerThrustPerPower: Thrust a simple propeller makes per unit of engine power.
Propulsion.PropellerTopSpeed: Speed, in m/s, at which simple propellers stop giving thrust.
Propulsion.SailTopSpeed: Speed, in m/s, at which sails stop pushing the craft.
Propulsion.SteamJetClearance: Empty space, in metres, a steam jet needs behind it to work at full strength.
Propulsion.SteamJetTopSpeed: Speed, in m/s, at which steam jets stop giving thrust.
Propulsion.WheelMaxTurnAngle: Largest steering angle of turning wheels, in degrees.
Propulsion.WheelThrustPerPower: Driving force a drive wheel makes per unit of engine power.
Propulsion.WingMaxForceAtSpeed: Speed, in m/s, above which wings stop making more lift.
SharedWeapon.BaseHeatMetric: Base value used to work out how hot a weapon's hit or shot is, which infrared sensors can detect.
SharedWeapon.BaseSquashAp: Armour piercing of the spall fragments from squash-head (HESH) hits.
SharedWeapon.FragAP: Armour piercing of frag fragments from shells and warheads. Shown in the frag damage tooltip.
SharedWeapon.HeatAP: Armour piercing of the jet fragments from HEAT (shaped charge) shells and warheads.
SharedWeapon.HeatFragAngle: Spread angle, in degrees, of the fragments from HEAT hits. Narrower spreads concentrate the damage.
SharedWeapon.HeatFragFraction: Share of a HEAT charge's power that becomes fragment damage. Higher values make HEAT shells and warheads do more damage behind armour.
SharedWeapon.HeatHeshDirectDamagePenalty: How much harder it is for HEAT and squash-head hits to destroy a block directly. Higher values make these hits rely more on fragments.
SharedWeapon.HoldFireSecsAfterInit: Seconds a weapon waits before it may fire after a craft spawns or the weapon is placed.
SharedWeapon.ProjectileArmor: Armour value of shells in flight (APS and CRAM). Higher values make shells harder for anti-missile and close-in defences to shoot down.
SharedWeapon.RecoilForce: Strength of the recoil push weapons put on their craft when they fire. Higher values make big guns shove the ship around more.
SharedWeapon.SquashExponent: How strongly armour reduces squash-head (HESH) spall damage. Higher values make thick armour block more of it.
SharedWeapon.SquashFragAngle: Spread angle, in degrees, of the spall fragments from squash-head (HESH) hits.
SharedWeapon.SquashFragFraction: Share of a squash-head shell's damage that becomes spall fragments.
Shell.FragVelocity: Speed, in m/s, of fragments thrown out by exploding shells.
Shell.ModuleStandardDiameter: Diameter, in metres, that APS shell module stats are based on (0.5 m = 500 mm). Affects shell length and barrel recoil cooling. Changing it rescales a lot of APS maths.
Steam.BaseBoilerMatPerSec: Materials a small steam boiler can burn per second (medium and large boilers scale from this). More burning means more steam.
Steam.BaseBoilerVolume: Steam storage volume of a small boiler (medium and large scale from this).
Steam.BaseCrankMotorPower: Most power a small crank motor can draw (medium and large scale from this).
Steam.BaseDrillEnergyPerHit: Kinetic energy a small steam drill spends per hit (medium and large scale from this).
Steam.BaseGearboxPower: Power a steam gearbox or crank generator can handle, before size scaling.
Steam.BaseKineticLoss: Friction loss on steam crankshafts. Higher values waste more energy.
Steam.BasePistonSteamPerSec: Steam a small piston can use per second (larger pistons scale from this).
Steam.BasePistonVolume: Steam storage volume of a small piston (larger pistons scale from this).
Steam.BasePropEnergyPerSec: Energy per second a small steam propeller can use (larger propellers scale from this).
Steam.BaseShaftEnergy: Kinetic energy a small crankshaft part can hold (larger parts scale from this).
Steam.BaseShaftRotationHz: Base crankshaft spin speed, in turns per second (each size multiplies this).
Steam.BaseTankVolume: Steam storage volume of a small steam tank (medium and large scale from this).
Steam.BaseTransmissionRate: Energy per second a small steam transmission can pass on (larger sizes scale from this).
Steam.BaseTurbineFrictionLoss: Friction loss on steam turbines. Higher values waste more energy.
Steam.BaseTurbineMaxKinetic: Kinetic energy a small turbine can hold (larger sizes scale from this).
Steam.BaseTurbineSteamPerSec: Steam a small turbine can use per second (larger sizes scale from this).
Steam.BoilerFirePerOutput: How big the fire is when a working boiler is destroyed, per steam output.
Steam.BoilerHeatPerMat: Heat a boiler gives off per material burned, which infrared sensors can see.
Steam.BoilerHePerFireFuel: Explosion strength when a boiler is destroyed, per unit of fire fuel it held.
Steam.CapacityPerVolumeUnit: Steam stored per unit of steam volume (boilers, tanks, pistons). Higher values let steam systems hold more.
Steam.CrankGeneratorEfficiency: Share of crankshaft energy a steam crank generator turns into electricity (0.9 = 90%).
Steam.CrankMotorEfficiency: Share of electricity a crank motor turns into crankshaft energy (0.6 = 60%).
Steam.DrillAp: Armour piercing of steam crank drills.
Steam.DrillDamagePerEnergy: Damage steam crank drills do per unit of kinetic energy used.
Steam.ExhaustMaxSizeAt: Steam flow at which steam exhaust and jet effects reach full size. Visual only.
Steam.GearboxConstantLoss: Fixed friction loss in steam gearboxes and crankshafts.
Steam.JetThrustPerSteam: Thrust a steam jet makes per unit of steam.
Steam.MaxCrankOutputPerKinetic: Most power a crankshaft can deliver per unit of stored kinetic energy.
Steam.MaxTurbineBladeFactor: Share of steam processed per turbine blade at high pressure drop.
Steam.MinTurbineBladeFactor: Share of steam processed per turbine blade at low pressure drop.
Steam.PistonWasteFactor: Share of steam a piston passes on rather than turning into motion (0.6 = 60%).
Steam.PropellerTopSpeed: Speed, in m/s, at which steam crank propellers stop giving thrust.
Steam.PropForceForEnergyPerSec: Thrust a steam crank propeller makes per unit of energy per second.
Steam.SteamPerMaterial: Steam made per material burned. Used for efficiency figures in steam tooltips.
Steam.TooltipBarWidth: Width of steam tooltip bars, in pixels. Visual only.
Steam.TooltipWidth: Width of steam tooltips, in pixels. Visual only.
Steam.VentFactor: How quickly steam vents and pistons release excess pressure.
WarpDrive.DetectionPerWarpEnergy: Heat a warp drive gives off per unit of warp energy used, which infrared sensors can see.
WarpDrive.DistancePerEnergy: Warp distance per unit of energy (divided by the craft's mass). Higher values let craft warp further.
WarpDrive.ForcePerMassAndDistance: How hard a warp jump pushes the craft, per tonne and metre warped.
WarpDrive.GlobalWarpCooldown: Shortest time, in seconds, between any two warps by the same craft.
WarpDrive.HoldFireSecsAfterWarp: Seconds a craft's weapons cannot fire after it warps.
WarpDrive.MaxStabilizationTime: Seconds a warp drive needs to stabilise between warps, before stabilisers are added.
WarpDrive.MaxVehicleSafetyDistance: Largest safety gap, in metres, a warp keeps from other craft.
WarpDrive.MinVehicleSafetyDistance: Smallest safety gap, in metres, a warp keeps from other craft.
WarpDrive.RodCapacity: Warp energy each metre of warp rod can store.
WarpDrive.RodEnergyPerSec: Warp energy each metre of warp rod charges per second.
WarpDrive.StabilizationTimeDiff: Seconds of stabilisation time that a full set of stabilisers removes.
WarpDrive.TerrainSafetyDistance: Safety gap, in metres, a warp keeps from terrain.
WarpDrive.TooltipBarWidth: Width of warp drive tooltip bars, in pixels. Visual only.
WarpDrive.TooltipWidth: Width of warp drive tooltips, in pixels. Visual only.
WarpDrive.VehicleSafetyDistance: Safety gap from other craft as a share of the warp distance (0.2 = 20%), kept between the min and max safety distance.
WarpDrive.VehicleSafetyStep: Step size, in metres, used when searching for a safe spot to warp to.
